name: Macro
author: Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments)
credits: After Mutable Instruments Plaits by Emilie Gillet (MIT)

summary.en: Eight synthesis models in one voice, after Plaits
summary.ja: 8つの合成モデルを1つの声で。Plaits に倣って

fm1_note.en: Wave plays 4 voices, Harm 5 (each costs about twice a Retro voice)
fm1_note.ja: Wave は 4 声、Harm は 5 声（どちらも Retro の声の約 2 倍の重さ）
